product_names.name: DocFoundry.app
product_names.short_tagline: Forge any document into clean, usable data.
product_names.positioning: For SaaS teams, ops, and automation builders who need reliable, template-driven document extraction with first-class APIs, webhooks, and workflow integrations.

product_names.name: ParseForge
product_names.short_tagline: Shape messy docs into precise data streams.
product_names.positioning: For developers and operations leaders who want a robust, API-first platform to transform PDFs, scans, and forms into structured JSON, CSV, and Excel.

product_names.name: DocCircuit
product_names.short_tagline: Wire documents directly into your workflows.
product_names.positioning: For automation consultants and ops teams who need document data to flow cleanly through Zapier, Make, n8n, and custom pipelines without manual cleanup.

product_names.name: StructifyDocs
product_names.short_tagline: From unstructured files to structured truth.
product_names.positioning: For finance, logistics, and HR teams that need consistent, validated data from receipts, invoices, and forms, without building their own OCR stack.

product_names.name: DatumFlow
product_names.short_tagline: Let your documents feed your systems.
product_names.positioning: For SaaS companies and SMEs that want multi-tenant, metered document extraction as a service, complete with audit logs, billing, and team workspaces.

product_names.name: DocRelay
product_names.short_tagline: Capture, extract, and deliver document data.
product_names.positioning: For product teams and integrators who need a reliable relay from uploads and scans to clean webhooks and exports, with full observability and retries.

product_names.name: IngestGrid
product_names.short_tagline: Gridlock your document chaos into clean data.
product_names.positioning: For engineering and ops leaders who want to centralize document ingestion, templating, and exports in one scalable, multi-tenant SaaS.

brand_voice: Technical but approachable: speak to developers, ops, and finance users with clear, concrete language, avoiding buzzwords and unnecessary jargon.
Confident and precise: emphasize accuracy, observability, and SLAs using specifics (logs, quotas, retries, metrics) rather than vague promises.
Action-oriented and instructional: favor step-by-step guidance, code-ready examples, and direct calls to action that help users reach first extraction and integration quickly.
Calm, trustworthy, and compliance-aware: maintain a steady, professional tone around billing, audit logs, and sensitive documents—no jokes around risk or security.
API-first and automation-minded: naturally reference APIs, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n, and CI/CD workflows, like a senior engineer walking a teammate through implementation.

primary.usage: Primary actions (CTAs), main navigation highlights, key status indicators, and links in both the dashboard and marketing site.

secondary.usage: Top navigation background, headers, sidebars, and high-emphasis panels such as admin, security, and billing sections.

accent.usage: Success states, healthy system badges, usage-under-limit charts, confirmation toasts, and subtle UI accents (icons, borders).

background.usage: Primary app background, marketing sections, and the canvas behind cards, tables, and modals to keep the UI light and low-noise.

text.usage: Default body text, labels, documentation, and any long-form content that needs strong readability on light backgrounds.

logo_concepts: Wordmark 'DocFoundry.app' in a modern geometric sans-serif, with a minimal icon of a document transforming into a structured grid of squares, using primary blue with a subtle green accent.
Compact symbol of a stylized anvil or forge combined with a document outline, implying raw documents being forged into data; paired with straightforward, uppercase text for the product name.
Layered document sheets resolving into rows and columns (table/grid) inside a rounded square icon, suggesting transformation from chaos to structure, with a clean, lowercase logotype.

A pipeline-style icon: an input document on the left, a segmented pipe, and clean JSON brackets or table cells on the right, indicating end-to-end processing; text set in a calm but technical sans-serif.
Abstract mark of connected nodes forming a document shape or bracketed frame, hinting at APIs and automation flows, supported by a balanced wordmark that feels enterprise-ready.
